description: This file implements the core logic of the AppManager component within the WPEFramework plugin architecture. It manages application lifecycle events, registration of notifications, app launching, termination, property management, and package handling. It interacts with various remote services such as storage, package, and lifecycle managers, and handles event dispatching and internal state updates.

classes.name: AppManagerImplementation
classes.description: Main class implementing application management functionalities, event handling, and remote service interactions within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for app events.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a notification callback.

methods.name: dispatchEvent
methods.description: Dispatches an event asynchronously to the worker pool.

methods.name: Dispatch
methods.description: Handles various app events and notifies registered observers.

methods.name: handleOnAppUnloaded

methods.name: handleOnAppLaunchRequest
